items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: I think the only one there on that circuit was Ella B. Moore in Dallas.

ctx.x: San Antonio didn't have a TOBA. I think the only one there on that circuit was Ella B. Moore in Dallas. And Ella B. Moore...
Somebody's behind him there on a reed. You can just barely hear him. You'll hear him in a minute. Well, let's stop now. I think it was this.
